algorithm.meaning: The allocator compares the candidate block size against the aligned request before deciding whether to split it; the delay slot separately prepares the following address comparison.

cause: The generated C++ sampled conditional branch operands after executing the architectural delay slot. At 0x1274 the delay slot overwrote r1, converting the required not-taken decision into taken and cycling through 0x12bc.
fix: Capture conditional predicates and indirect jump targets when the control-transfer instruction issues, before executing its delay slot.
